values: External interface layer implemented by ColdChainX.API. It configures the backend host and exposes HTTP APIs while coordinating authorization, middleware, runtime services, and hosted workers.
Provides extension methods for environment loading, dependency registration, service configuration, and database bootstrap operations.
Exposes REST endpoints and translates incoming HTTP requests into application use cases and standardized API responses.
Implements permission-based access control through custom attributes, authorization requirements, policy providers, and handlers.
Processes cross-cutting HTTP pipeline concerns, including global exception handling and consistent error-response generation.
Hosts API-level runtime services for Redis, MQTT commands, cold-chain monitoring and risk evaluation, and temporary Google login-code storage.
Contains API-side implementations of application abstractions, including the Redis-backed real-time telemetry service.
Runs background processes for MQTT telemetry, telemetry processing, IoT watchdog checks, auto-invoicing, inventory aging, booking updates, and fleet compliance.
Business logic layer implemented by ColdChainX.Application. It orchestrates use cases and workflows while remaining independent of infrastructure implementations.
Organizes commands, queries, handlers, and application events by business area, including claims, warehouse flows, inventory, and delivery operations.
Implements application workflows for authentication, warehouses, receipts, claims, inventory analysis, compliance, cargo compatibility, and related use cases.
Defines application ports and service contracts for persistence, notifications, real-time messaging, routing, payments, external systems, and technical adapters.
Contains request, response, and transfer models used to move validated data across API, application, and integration boundaries.
Defines FluentValidation rules for commands and request models before business workflows are executed.
Provides object-mapping profiles used to convert between domain entities, DTOs, requests, and responses.
Core business domain layer implemented by ColdChainX.Core. It contains framework-independent business entities, controlled values, and repository contracts.
Defines domain and persistence entities for users, roles, orders, warehouses, vehicles, inventory, telemetry, claims, contracts, and delivery operations.
Defines controlled domain values and lifecycle states used consistently across business rules and persisted entities.
Declares repository abstractions for core aggregates such as users, warehouses, vehicles, drivers, and warehouse receipts.
Technical implementation layer provided by ColdChainX.Infrastructure. It supplies persistence, repositories, technical services, real-time hubs, integrations, and ML resources.
Contains the Entity Framework Core database context and factory, SQL bootstrap or repair scripts, and schema migrations for the PostgreSQL database.
Implements Core repository interfaces using the infrastructure persistence layer and Entity Framework Core.
Implements application ports and external adapters for routing, maps, payments, notifications, files, PDFs, dispatching, fleet operations, and warehouse flows.
Provides real-time SignalR endpoints for notifications, operational monitoring, and chat communication.
Contains the Gemini load-optimization integration together with machine-learning datasets, trained models, and cold-chain analysis configuration.
Cross-cutting package implemented by ColdChainX.Shared and reused by API, Application, and Infrastructure without introducing domain or infrastructure coupling.
Defines shared configuration settings, permission codes and effects, authentication settings, and common workflow status values.
Defines typed exceptions for validation, conflicts, missing resources, forbidden actions, API failures, and external-service errors.
Provides standard API response envelopes and reusable pagination models for consistent endpoint output.
